title: HighLevel API Documentation
snippet:
## **API Access Across HighLevel Plans**
HighLevel provides API access across all subscription plans, including Starter, Unlimited, and Agency Pro.
Both **OAuth 2.0** and **Private Integration Tokens (PIT)** are available across all plans, allowing developers to build integrations and access supported APIs without requiring an Agency Pro subscription.
API Availability
| API capability | Starter ($97) | Unlimited ($297) | Agency Pro ($497) |
|---|---|---|---|
| OAuth 2.0 authentication | Available | Available | Available |
| Private Integration Tokens (PIT) | Available | Available | Available |
| Standard API endpoints | Available | Available | Available |
| Agency Pro-restricted endpoints | Not available | Not available | Available |
**Agency Pro-Restricted Endpoints**
While standard API access is available across all plans, certain endpoints require an Agency Pro ($497/month) subscription.
The following endpoints are currently documented as requiring Agency Pro:
| Endpoint | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [Create Sub-Account](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/locations/create-location) | Create a new sub-account programmatically. |
| [Enable SaaS for Sub-Account](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/saas-api/enable-saas-location) | Enable SaaS functionality for a sub-account. |
**Note:** Additional endpoint-specific restrictions may apply. Refer to the [official HighLevel API documentation](https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/) for the latest requirements and supported API versions.
**Important Notes**
- OAuth 2.0 and PIT availability is not restricted by subscription tier.
- Access to individual endpoints depends on the required permissions, scopes, and applicable plan restrictions.
- Agency Pro is required only for endpoints or capabilities explicitly restricted to that plan.

**Q. Is API access available on all HighLevel plans?**
API access varies by plan:
- Starter & Unlimited: Basic API access
- Founder Plan: Advanced API access, including OAuth and agency-level tokens
Some endpoints may only be available on higher plans.

HighLevel supports API access across its subscription plans. Both OAuth 2.0 and Private Integration Tokens are available, but some API endpoints have additional plan requirements.
**Current Subscription Plans
**
| Plan | Monthly Price | API Access |
|---|---|---|
| Starter | $97 | Standard API access, subject to endpoint restrictions |
| Unlimited | $297 | Basic API Access |
| Founder | $497 | Advanced API Access |
| Enterprise | Custom Pricing | Full highest-tier feature set; increased API limits available by request |
**API Availability**
| API Capability | Starter | Unlimited | Founder $497 |
|---|---|---|---|
| OAuth 2.0 | Available | Available | Available |
| Private Integration Tokens | Available | Available | Available |
| Standard API Endpoints | Available | Available | Available |
| Higher-Tier Restricted Endpoints | Restricted | Restricted | Subject to endpoint eligibility |
**Plan-Restricted API Endpoints**
Certain API operations require higher-tier access. The API documentation currently identifies the following Agency Pro-restricted endpoints:
- **Create Sub-Account:** Create new sub-accounts programmatically.
- **Enable SaaS for Sub-Account:** Enable SaaS functionality for a sub-account.
**Important:** Having a Private Integration Token does not automatically grant access to every API endpoint. Access also depends on the subscription plan, assigned scopes, account permissions, and endpoint-specific requirements.
For current subscription details, visit [HighLevel Pricing](https://www.gohighlevel.com/pricing).

title: GoHighLevel API: access, keys and rate limits
snippet:
It comes with the paid plans, the old v1 API keys are end of life, and new work uses a Private Integration token or OAuth 2.0 under a limit of 100 requests per 10 seconds.

| GoHighLevel API at a glance | |
|---|---|
| Versions | v3 (latest), plus dated versions back to 2021; v1 keys ended support December 31, 2025 |
| How you sign in | Private Integration token (your own account) or OAuth 2.0 (Marketplace apps) |
| Plans | Basic API on Unlimited ($297), Advanced on Agency Pro ($497); Starter per the help center only |
| Rate limit | 100 requests per 10 seconds, 200,000 per day, per app per sub-account |
| Webhooks | More than 70 events, retried up to 12 times |
| API fee | None published; usage and premium workflow steps are billed |

GoHighLevel's [pricing page](https://www.gohighlevel.com/pricing) lists Basic API Access on Unlimited ($297 a month) and Advanced API Access on Agency Pro ($497). Starter ($97) has no API line on the pricing page, but HighLevel's help center says Basic access is included with Starter too.

| Plan | Price a month | Pricing page | Help center |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter | $97 | No API line | Basic API access |
| Unlimited | $297 | Basic API Access | Basic API access |
| Agency Pro | $497 | Advanced API Access | Advanced, with OAuth and agency-level tokens |
| Enterprise | Quote only | "Increase API Limit by request" | Not listed |

### Is the GoHighLevel API free?
HighLevel publishes no separate fee for the GoHighLevel API. You pay for the plan. What adds up is the usage around it. Calls, texts, email and AI are billed by use, and the workflow steps that send or catch webhooks are premium: $0.01 a run after 100 free, or a Workflow Pro add-on at $10, $25 or $50 a month per sub-account ([HighLevel pricing guide](https://help.gohighlevel.com/support/solutions/articles/155000001156-highlevel-pricing-guide)). What a full bill looks like for a sales team is in our [GoHighLevel pricing breakdown](/blog/gohighlevel-pricing/).

| HubSpot ([usage limits](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/usage-details)) | 100 to 190 per 10 seconds, per app | 250,000 to 1,000,000 per account, by tier |
| Pipedrive ([rate limiting](https://pipedrive.readme.io/docs/core-api-concepts-rate-limiting)) | 20 to 120 per 2 seconds, per user token, by plan | 30,000 tokens × plan multiplier × seats |

title: GoHighLevel API: Keys, Plans, Limits and How to Connect
snippet:
GoHighLevel's help center says Starter and Unlimited get basic API access, and Agency Pro gets advanced access. For a one-account tool, make a Private Integration token in Settings and send it as a Bearer token with a Version header. For an app many accounts install, use OAuth 2.0. Limits: 100 requests per 10 seconds and 200,000 a day.

All three plans have some API access, but only Agency Pro has the advanced kind. Here is what GoHighLevel's pricing page and its help article said on 18 October 2026:
| Plan | Price | Pricing page says | Help article says |
|---|---|---|---|
| Starter | $97 a month or $970 a year | No API line in the plan card | Basic API access |
| Unlimited | $297 a month or $2,970 a year | "Basic API Access" | Basic API access |
| Agency Pro | $497 a month or $4,970 a year | "Advanced API Access" | Advanced API access |
| Enterprise | No price listed | "Increase API Limit by request" | Not covered |

### Is the GoHighLevel API free?
There is no separate API fee on GoHighLevel's pricing page. Access comes with your plan. The help article says Starter and Unlimited get basic access and Agency Pro, at $497 a month, gets advanced access. Usage-based fees are separate from the plan, and GoHighLevel's trial page says they can still apply.
### Does GoHighLevel Starter have API access?
GoHighLevel's help article says yes, basic access. But the pricing page only lists "Basic API Access" on the Unlimited plan, checked 18 October 2026. If the API is your main reason for buying, ask support which endpoints Starter can use before you choose it. Only Agency Pro has advanced access.

title: GoHighLevel API Key in 2026: Private Integrations and v2
snippet:
To get API access in GoHighLevel today, create a Private Integration token. In your sub-account or agency, go to Settings, then Private Integrations, click Create new Integration, give it a name, pick only the scopes you need, and copy the token. HighLevel shows it only once, so store it somewhere safe.
Then send it with every request to `https://services.leadconnectorhq.com` as `Authorization: Bearer` plus a `Version` header. If you don't have an account yet, HighLevel's standard trial is 14 days, but my link gives you 30 days free, which is plenty of time to build and test an integration.

title: GoHighLevel API: rate limits, plan requirements and the v1 deadline that passed
snippet:
**The v2 API is free to use and allows 100 requests per 10 seconds and 200,000 per day, counted per Marketplace app per resource.** Private Integration Tokens cover a single location and work on any plan. OAuth 2.0, which a Marketplace app requires, needs Agency Pro at $497 a month. v1 reached end of support on 31 December 2025 and still functions, unsupported.

- OAuth is an Agency Pro feature. Build a Marketplace app on a cheaper plan and you stop at authentication.

30 day free trial through HighLevel's Bootcamp offer, card required.

|
| v1 status | End of support since 31 December 2025. Existing connections keep working, but get no support and no updates. |
| Authentication | Private Integration Tokens for a single location, OAuth 2.0 for Marketplace apps and multi-location access. |
| Burst limit | 100 requests per 10 seconds, per Marketplace app. |
| Daily limit | 200,000 requests per day, per Marketplace app, per resource. |
| Cost | No charge for the API itself. Usage-based charges still apply to anything it triggers. |

API access by plan
| Plan | Level | What that means |
|---|---|---|
| Starter, $97 | Basic | Location API keys. No OAuth, no agency-level access. |
| Unlimited, $297 | Basic | Location API keys, the same as Starter despite the pricing page listing "Basic API Access" as an Unlimited feature. |
| Agency Pro, $497 | Advanced | OAuth 2.0 and agency API keys, which is what a Marketplace app needs. |

Yes, there is no charge for API calls themselves. Anything the calls trigger is still billed as usual, so an API-fired workflow that sends SMS draws from the agency wallet at the normal per-segment rate.
### Which GoHighLevel plan do I need for API access?
Private Integration Tokens for a single location work on any plan. OAuth 2.0 and agency API keys, which a public Marketplace app needs, require Agency Pro at $497 a month. Note that HighLevel’s pricing page and help centre describe Starter’s access differently, so confirm with support before subscribing on that basis.
